crossRefs.note: Isaac sowed in that land, and reaped in the same year one hundred times what he planted. Yahweh blessed him.
In the seven plenteous years the earth produced abundantly.
The tents of robbers prosper. Those who provoke God are secure, who carry their god in their hands.
For I was envious of the arrogant, when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.
Behold, these are the wicked. Being always at ease, they increase in riches.
For she didn’t know that I gave her the grain, the new wine, and the oil, and multiplied to her silver and gold, which…
that you may be children of your Father who is in heaven. For he makes his sun to rise on the evil and the good, and…
Yet he didn’t leave himself without witness, in that he did good and gave you rains from the sky and fruitful seasons…

translations.web: He spoke a parable to them, saying, “The ground of a certain rich man produced abundantly.
translations.bsb: Then He told them a parable: “The ground of a certain rich man produced an abundance.
translations.kjv: And he spake a parable unto them, saying, The ground of a certain rich man brought forth plentifully:
translations.asv: And he spake a parable unto them, saying, The ground of a certain rich man brought forth plentifully:
